name: Somber Freeze
description: The Traveler regenerates 5 Elemental Energy when they deal Stellar Glimmer DMG. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.

name: Frostfall Reverberation
description:
The active character's Elemental Mastery is increased by 60 for 5s when an opponent is hit by an ice crystal fired by the Elemental Skill Ice Fog Piercer.
Additionally, when a character affected by the aforementioned effect triggers a Stellar Glimmer reaction or deals Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG, the Elemental Mastery boost described above will be increased to 120 for its duration.

name: Glacial Shard
description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Burst Frostbound Javelin by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

name: Enduring Ice
description: The duration of the Frostpierce Star created by the Elemental Skill Ice Fog Piercer is increased by 25%.

name: Bittercold Fog
description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill Ice Fog Piercer by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

name: Brumal Grimfrost
description: Every stack of Frostglow consumed when using the Elemental Burst Frostbound Javelin increases Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by other party members by 5% for 15s. A maximum 40% increase can be obtained in this way.
